args.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept. ONE NEW landscape1536x1024 transparent PNG KFB ink monster sheet, EXACTLY SIX different actors in THREE COLUMNS by TWO ROWS.
The supplied PNGs are STYLE REFERENCES ONLY: first for complete soft rounded charcoal-violet ink blob anatomy, sculpted lids and rich plasticine; second for crafted props in clay wood, metal, leather and cloth. New family, not edit targets or costume/face copies.
Subject: fictional ancient woodland warrior clan, absurd cartoon mix of Gaul/Germanic/Teutonic/barbarian adventure archetypes, imagined as rivals to a Roman legion. This is playful fantasy costume design, not portraits or an ethnographic reconstruction. Loose internal hierarchy: boastful chief, stern war-leader, doubting elder, enraged champion, cunning scout, covetous spoils-keeper. Six lovable flawed individual personalities, not six identical raging warriors. Two female-read characters. Copper/iron, wood, dull bronze, checked cloth scraps, muted ochre/teal/red, chunky torcs and hand-forged equipment, no Roman armor or modern stuff. No text, named real nation, symbols, runic lettering, flags, scene or gore.

Anatomy/style STRICT: one COMPLETE UPRIGHT FOOTLESS charcoal-black ink splat each, subtle deep-purple tonal sheen. Thick soft rounded asymmetric lobes, huge face directly in goo, short rounded goo hands and a few detached drops within cell. Clothing/helmets/hair are partial accessories, most ink body remains dominant. No human torso, legs, feet, bust, fur body, angular rocks or spiky anatomy. Rich soft sculpted plasticine, fine fingerprints, rounded volumes, restrained material wear, offbeat handmade cartoon appeal, avoid polished Pixar human mascots.
Eyes ALL WHITE/IVORY eyeballs enclosing small RED iris and BLACK pupil, thick fully violet-black clay lids. No all-red glowing eyeballs. Individual facial proportions, gaze, brows, mouths, lip weights, irregular ivory teeth. No dangling tongues. No six repeated angry V-brows/grins.

TOP LEFT — MALE-READ BOASTFUL CHIEF. Huge wide pear blob with one fat sagging crown loop. Worn round iron helmet with TWO SHORT blunt curved cream horns, thick short red-brown clay moustache bent outward, simple bronze torc. Enormous delighted boast at peak: eyes opened to very different widths, one brow lifted, broad sideways laughing mouth with three widely spaced uneven teeth. One hand holds ONE squat wooden-hilt iron SWORD low at own side, other holds ONE small thick DRINKING HORN against own belly. No human beard-covered torso; mouth remains visible below small moustache.
TOP MIDDLE — FEMALE-READ WAR LEADER. Tall thick hooked bean body, two small dark clay braids, battered bronze headband with a small round disc, no horned helmet. Utter stern impatience, heavy lower lip thrust forward, narrowed white eyes looking SIDEWAYS, one single small upper tooth, brow raised on one side rather than same V-shape. Holds ONE SHORT stout SPEAR vertically at side and ONE small ROUND blue-painted wooden SHIELD close against lower body, clear hand grips; shield covers at most a quarter of blob. Short checked ochre shoulder cloth.
TOP RIGHT — MALE-READ DOUBTING ELDER / DRUID. Round lopsided dumpling blob with one long curved goo droplet at side. Small stitched moss-green hood draped only over top/shoulder, two short ivory clay moustache tips, no full white beard hiding face. Extremely suspicious sleepy half-lidded sideways glance, closed crooked downturned mouth with one irregular lower tooth. Holds ONE rounded bronze SICKLE with thick wooden grip and ONE little BUNDLE OF MISTLETOE tied with cord, both low and readable. He seems to be inspecting whether the foliage is taking its responsibilities seriously. No magical glow, potions or floating runes.
BOTTOM LEFT — MALE-READ CHAMPION / CLUB WARRIOR. Broad near-square soft lobed splat with three fat crown nubs. One rusty iron brow band, a short leather strap with a small round buckle, minimal tufty clay shoulder scrap. Furious baffled determination: bulging white eyes looking UP at crooked angles, tight sideways CLENCHED teeth, massive bent lower lip and asymmetrical heavy brow. Holds ONE ridiculous short thick knotted wooden WAR CLUB with three rounded wooden knobs, hugged close at an angle within own cell. No huge raised weapon or muscular human arms. Strong contained body tension, standing upright.
BOTTOM MIDDLE — FEMALE-READ CUNNING SCOUT. Compact upright tapered splat with soft wavy lobe outline, simple muted teal headband and two short red clay side braids, subtle lashes. Assessing near-smile: one enormous white eye peers SIDEWAYS, other narrowed, gently arched brow, almost CLOSED asymmetric sly lip curl with two tiny offset teeth. Holds ONE short thick simple WOODEN BOW beside body and ONE blunt chunky arrow close to own chest, not aiming across cell. Visible bowstring connects both tips. A single small leather pouch, no cloak covering body.
BOTTOM RIGHT — MALE-READ SPOILS KEEPER / JUNIOR RETAINER. Tall top-heavy crooked blob, folded brown checked shoulder scrap, plain bronze circlet sliding over one eye, round clay side curl. Anxious covetous concentration: unequal white eyes staring DOWN, upper lip pinched to one side and one large central tooth, enormous lower lip, brows curled upward at inner ends. Clutches ONE upturned battered bronze HELMET filled with THREE oversized GOLD COINS, like a miserly fruit bowl; one finger counts a coin still inside the helmet. No scattered treasure or scene. He is clearly guarding the count, not serving food.

Composition crucial: six LARGE complete characters in a clean regular3x2 visual grid. Same substantial BODY HEIGHT across both rows. Design whole silhouettes to occupy450-475px of each512pxcell, safe margins, hats/horns/weapons/droplets INSIDE own cell, clear gutters between actors and rows. Keep at least32px transparent gap between rows, no props on seams, no overlap/touching and no cropped details. Do not shrink the entire bottom row. No gridlines, background, floor, shadow disk, matte, gradient, checkerboard, halo, text or watermark. Real alpha-zero transparent surroundings with opaque character interiors and clean antialiased edges. Soft upper-left studio light on figures only.
